title: final_quantity_proof — post-cancel late-event window

args.note: P0-2 T2 wave-3 order session 2026-07-31. MINI front month A05608 (the account funds only one FULL contract at a time — P-2-20260731T014957Z). Post-cancel late-event window 120s default. Context for interpreting any absence: observed today that an inquire-ccnl row with qty>0 is NOT necessarily a live cancellable order — 5 of 6 such rows refused cancellation with 모의투자 정정/취소할 수량이 없습니다, so row-field liveness is weaker evidence than the brokers own cancel response.

limit_price_tick.rounding_rationale: away from the touch — a resting probe depends on the order NOT filling, so a snap must never move the price toward the touch; P-11's marketable order is the mirror case and snaps further in

odno_wire_format.identity_matching: The two surfaces disagree on padding, so matching a submitted order against a query row must canonicalize BOTH sides (strip whitespace, then strip leading zeros). A raw strip-and-compare evaluates '762' == '0000000762' and never matches: artifact P-5-20260731T002112Z reported 1 CENSORED trial and n=0 for exactly that reason while the cleanup cancel of the same ODNO returned rt_cd=0, proving the order existed and the query had returned it.
odno_wire_format.reported_identifiers: Measurements that list ODNOs report canonical keys (leading zeros stripped). The verbatim wire forms are the samples above.
odno_wire_format.scope: One 모의투자 account, one session, mock environment. Recorded as the encoding observed here — not as a general KIS guarantee, and not extrapolated to 실전.

B_final_quantity_proof_candidate.label: submit_to_filled_plus_zero_remaining_ms
B_final_quantity_proof_candidate.statistic: hard maximum: ceil(max_observed x (1 + margin_pct/100)). p95/p99 are shape diagnostics and MUST NOT be proposed as the bound.
B_final_quantity_proof_candidate.sample_adequacy_note: A maximum estimated from a small sample understates the true maximum. Record n and the observation window with the value; the Bounds-Approver decides whether n is adequate.

measurements.granularity_note: Both candidates are polled observations and so carry up to one poll_granularity_ms of additive error (runbook §8.3). That value is the EFFECTIVE interval max(--poll-ms, --pace-s), not the requested --poll-ms: the pacer floors polling, and it also bounds how finely a post-terminal change can be located in time.

B_late_fill_observation_candidate.verdict: NOT_ESTABLISHED — zero late changes observed. Per VP-002:756 absence within a window is not proof of non-existence, so the field stays null and the capability stays UNKNOWN.
B_late_fill_observation_candidate.window_adequacy: The observation window must be strictly longer than the largest change seen; otherwise the window itself is the binding limit.

fqp_markers_required: no_later_change_asserted (ADR §15.4 marker — cannot be asserted from a single trial)

observations.quirk: Q-CXL-1: a cancel ack carries its OWN ODNO and proves nothing about the original order's final quantity (draft §5:186).

approval_note: This artifact records observations only. Writing any value into VERIFICATION-PROFILE-002.yaml requires a Bounds-Approver; writing any capability status into the Broker Capability Profile INSTANCE requires the P0-2 approval chain (draft memo §8).
